title: Changing the folder view icons size squeezes content in popup/standalone widget
line: Changing a Folder View widget's icon size no longer squeezes its icons into a small corner; they fill the whole widget.
explanation: The Folder View root item bound its width and height to preferredFolderSize (3x2 cells), meant only as the initial size when the widget is added. The binding stayed live after the applet container sized the widget, so any change of cell size (icon size, label mode) re-applied it and shrank the contents to 3x2 cells inside the larger container until the next resize or move. The change applies that size only until the item is parented in an applet container, then leaves sizing to the container.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: stop Folder View from resizing itself after it's placed

The Folder View widget bound its own size to its preferred size, meant
only as the initial size when added, so changing the icon size shrank its
contents to that size. Only apply it until the applet container sizes it.

BUG: 525079

patches.diff:
From 54c0694d7a04b7618cec1f859f2722f170427af5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 04:40:23 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: stop Folder View from resizing itself
 after it's placed

The Folder View widget bound its own size to its preferred size, meant
only as the initial size when added, so changing the icon size shrank its
contents to that size. Only apply it until the applet container sizes it.

BUG: 525079
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml | 13 +++++++++++--
 1 file changed, 11 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
index d3f413b2df..f699397bf4 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -35,8 +35,17 @@ ContainmentItem {
 
     objectName: isFolder ? "folder" : "desktop"
 
-    width: inPanel ? undefined : preferredFolderSize.width // Initial size when adding to e.g. desktop.
-    height: inPanel ? undefined : preferredFolderSize.height // Initial size when adding to e.g. desktop.
+    // Initial size when adding to e.g. desktop; once in an applet container, the container sizes it.
+    Binding on width {
+        when: !root.inPanel && !(root.parent instanceof ContainmentLayoutManager.ItemContainer)
+        value: root.preferredFolderSize.width
+        restoreMode: Binding.RestoreNone
+    }
+    Binding on height {
+        when: !root.inPanel && !(root.parent instanceof ContainmentLayoutManager.ItemContainer)
+        value: root.preferredFolderSize.height
+        restoreMode: Binding.RestoreNone
+    }
 
     function switchSize() {
         // Support expanding into the full representation on very thick vertical panels.
--

Fixed: same widget with large icons
